findings: Early nape edits turned masculine tips upward.
Feminine rear edge duplicates cut through the side curtain; overly strong tucking exposed a gap.
The initial Button-up hem produced a stiff waist flare.
Early white-eye pupils clipped the upper edge unevenly.

The first bikini silhouette looked like a belt. Raising the leg openings exposed disconnected hip/thigh construction. Subsequent bridge trials left a horizontal ridge, loose cloth corners and waistband/top overlap.
corrections: Constrained masculine nape paths downward while retaining main styling.
Removed buried duplicate edge locks and reduced surrounding tuck; preserved the front and crown design.
Smoothed and reduced the men's hem clearance envelope; added a conventional closed placket, buttons, seated folded collar and chest pocket.
Lowered pupil centers to keep the graphic pupils inside their white support.

Replaced the bikini's visible lower-body assembly with a smooth pelvis/thigh union. Extended the upper thighs into the hip before blending. Fitted and relaxed the cloth envelope, reduced crotch projection, and lowered the waistband clear of the tank hem.

coverage: Final bikini front, three-quarter, both profiles, rear and above at 1024px with actual materials.
42 contextual top/bottom assemblies from front, profile and rear; all eight feminine bikini assemblies rerendered after the last hip correction.
Both revised hairstyles and men's T-shirt/Button-up in six-angle renders; before/after hair comparison.
All four eyes for both builds in dark/white comparisons; side attachment review and 32/48/64/128px Soft square portraits.
Live mobile-width bikini assembly checked across the four skin choices, including contrasting White fabric; original leg copies hidden only for Bikini.
second_pass.assessment: Ready for owner review. The bikini cut reads as a moderate high-leg brief with a continuous hip/thigh outline; the earlier ridge, loose point and tank overlap are resolved in the reviewed views. Men now have Shorts/Pants and a closed Button-up; women's distinct festival silhouettes are retained. No obvious new garment penetrations or detached skin surfaces were observed in the final outfit sheets.
style_notes: The bodies deliberately retain spherical heads, floating hands and short rounded legs. This is a coherent cartoon interpretation, not realistic anatomy.
Sculpted hair-lock seams remain visible at close zoom; this pass corrects side/rear overlaps and tips rather than redesigning the accepted hairstyles.
Soft square is a graphic alternative to Narrow. White sclera and dark pupils remain an optional experiment; dark eyes stay the default.

limits: Static renders and desktop mobile-width browser checks do not certify physical-phone performance or owner aesthetic acceptance. No Avatar Studio or firmware/mobile/cloud wire changes.
